source.note: Generated from the working tree; runtime states reference artifacts/evidence.

routes.summary: Unified capture dashboard with live recorder status and recent local media.
routes.evidence: Rendered shell; navigation and recorder state wired to a single provider.

routes.summary: Real getDisplayMedia/getUserMedia capture through MediaRecorder with pause/resume and persisted output.
routes.evidence: RecordingSession records real timestamps from the active media stream; output is written to IndexedDB.

routes.summary: Real pixel capture from the display stream with PNG/JPEG/WebP encoding.
routes.evidence: Canvas drawImage from a live display stream; blob signature checked before saving.

routes.summary: Persistent local library with preview, rename, delete, export and trim.
routes.evidence: Items survive reload; object URLs are created from stored blobs, never placeholders.

routes.summary: Five templates render real canvas frames at any playhead and export real WebM video (canvas.captureStream + MediaRecorder); the 51 generated entries stay labelled as mock because they carry no template content.
routes.evidence: services/realTemplateEngine.ts evaluates element lifetimes and animation keyframes per frame; the PNG frame and WebM video are encoded from the same canvas. scripts/templates-smoke.mjs verifies the WebM container, dimensions, duration and animated frame differences.

routes.summary: Eight local media utilities with real processors: resize, filters, format conversion (PNG/JPEG/WebP), video thumbnail, waveform, text image, QR code and colour palette.
requirements: Web Audio decoder for the visualiser
routes.evidence: scripts/toolbox-smoke.mjs drove all eight tools through the UI (99/99 checks): real fixture inputs, invalid-input rejection, preview/saved/export SHA-256 equality, PNG/JPEG/WEBP signatures, cancellation, reload persistence and Arabic RTL.

routes.summary: Region based image editor with the fifty preserved tools and their real canvas processors: paint a region, apply the tool, compare, undo and export.
routes.evidence: scripts/visual-patch-smoke.mjs now verifies the full pipeline (21/21): paint, apply, pixel change, undo/redo, before/after repaint, reset, PNG export and the library blob signature. Individual algorithms beyond the driven tool family are not each proven.

routes.summary: Body-shape tool catalog preserved, but it depended on fictional .exe modules and fabricated output paths.
routes.evidence: services/knouxMorphCore.ts only simulates execution; no executable module or pixel pipeline exists.

routes.summary: Image editing workspace with slider filters, real presets, before/after comparison, verified PNG export and library save. The AI inference pipeline is not part of the bundle.
requirements: Model weights for the AI pipeline
routes.evidence: scripts/elysian-smoke.mjs drives the packaged binary (18/18): age gate, upload, preset filter, compare repaint, verified PNG export with independently decoded pixels, and the saved library blob signature.

routes.summary: Age-gated body editor UI preserved. It depends on segmentation models whose weight files are not distributed.
routes.evidence: public/models/*/model.json manifests exist, weights.bin files do not.

routes.summary: One unified catalog of 38 on-device tasks. 15 run now on deterministic local engines (DSP, canvas, container analysis); the other 23 stay blocked until their weight binaries exist.
requirements: Weight binaries for the 23 model tasks
routes.evidence: src/services/aiTasks.ts executes 15 tasks for real and src/services/aiDsp.ts is unit tested; scripts/ai-tools-smoke.mjs runs them in Chromium and inspects the produced bytes.

routes.summary: The Arabic entry point of the same 38 canonical tasks, with Arabic titles, descriptions and features taken from the preserved panel. The 15 deterministic tasks run here too.
requirements: Weight binaries for the 23 model tasks
routes.evidence: components/ArabicAIToolsPanel.tsx supplied the localized labels; four corrupted Arabic strings in that file were repaired; scripts/ai-tools-smoke.mjs runs a task on the Arabic route.

routes.summary: Model manifest inventory with explicit weight-file verification.
routes.evidence: Only model.json graph metadata ships; no weights.bin present.

routes.summary: Persisted appearance, language and recording defaults.
routes.evidence: Settings persist in localStorage and are applied to the document root.

routes.summary: Runtime capability matrix measured from MediaDevices, MediaRecorder and IndexedDB.
routes.evidence: Values computed in-browser; model availability proven by bundle inspection.

routes.summary: Shared execution workspace for every real job: media tools, template WebM exports and recordings, with live lifecycle events, media previews, verification and save/export.
requirements: Real jobs from the tool registry, template encoder or recorder
routes.evidence: scripts/live-studio-smoke.mjs ran 30 checks through the workspace: image job with live timeline and verified dock, save/reopen, real retry, before/after slider, audio playback plus waveform, template WebM preview, a fake-display recording, cancellation and Arabic RTL.

core.name: Screen recording
core.evidence: Headless Chrome fake display: 1920x1080 VP9/Opus WebM, patched finite duration, exported EBML signature.

core.name: Camera recording
core.evidence: Fake camera capture produced a 4.84s 1920x1080 VP9/Opus clip persisted in IndexedDB.

core.name: Pause and resume
core.evidence: recording-smoke.mjs pauses and resumes; elapsed time excludes paused spans.

core.name: Screenshot capture
core.evidence: Live display stream drew real pixels into canvas; 1920x1080 image saved and previewed.

core.name: Library persistence
core.evidence: IndexedDB objects survive full reload; blob URLs are recreated on hydrate.

core.name: Video trim
core.evidence: Trim re-encodes a range to a new item, patches WebM duration and keeps the original.

core.name: WebM duration patch
core.evidence: EBML Info>Duration injected; browser reports finite duration instead of Infinity.

core.name: Export download
core.evidence: Download produced a file starting with EBML magic 1a45dfa3.

core.name: Library favorites
core.evidence: Favorite flag persisted through libraryStore.setFavorite; UI filter is wired.

core.name: Settings persistence
core.evidence: Theme and language survive reload; document root receives theme/lang/dir.

core.name: Arabic RTL
core.evidence: Language toggle sets lang=ar dir=rtl with no horizontal overflow.

core.name: Back and forward navigation
core.evidence: ui-smoke.mjs verifies back returns to recorder and forward to library.

core.name: Permission error recovery
core.evidence: Denied camera shows an error notice, no fake preview, and Dismiss restores ready state.
